# Turn a Gumroad sales export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Gumroad sales to journal converter: proves the sales add up to your payout, splits product sales, shipping, tax you collected, Gumroad fees and refunds by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
